links.outcome: Traceability of consumer LLM model versions for replication
links.effect: Models changed without traceable version identifiers, preventing reliable replication of evaluations.
links.quote: Models changed without traceable version identifiers, preventing reliable replication.

links.outcome: Feasibility of independent context-specific evaluation of consumer health LLM risks
links.effect: Five linked barriers found, including terms-of-service and rate limits, non-resettable interfaces, and unsuitable accuracy criteria. No reliable independent evaluation framework exists.
links.quote: No reliable independent evaluation framework yet exists for examining how consumer-facing health LLMs behave in ordinary use.

unlisted_practices: Disclosure of personalization signals by consumer LLM providers
Researcher safe harbor programs for independent testing of consumer LLMs
Stable version identifiers for consumer-facing LLMs
Post-deployment monitoring of health-related outputs of consumer LLMs

screen.reason: Empirical study using simulated user personas and multi-turn conversations to evaluate sycophancy, response variation, and methodological barriers to auditing consumer-facing health LLMs; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
